faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS DH Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the TISS DH Supervisor position is 31st August 2026. Ensure you apply before this deadline to be considered.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the DH Supervisor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be a Graduate with a minimum of 55% marks and have two years of experience as a Catering Assistant, OR have passed 12th grade with at least 60% marks, a diploma in Hotel Management & Catering, and three years of supervisory experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the DH Supervisor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the DH Supervisor post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the DH Supervisor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the DH Supervisor position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the TISS DH Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 125/- for SC/ST candidates. Women candidates are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the TISS DH Supervisor post must be submitted online through the official website of TISS.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DH Supervisor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Interaction, a Skill Test, and a Written Test.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for the DH Supervisor position.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for TISS DH Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification by clicking on the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The DH Supervisor position is a contractual role, meaning it is offered on a fixed-term contract basis.
